mechanism_narrative: Sustained recovery in workplace attendance, evidenced by WORKPLACES mobility consistently increasing week-on-week, will continue to drive more people out of their homes and into commercial areas, leading to a positive shift in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES showing a net increase over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: The ongoing recovery in transit station activity, if TRANSIT mobility surpasses -20% from baseline, will signify a critical mass of return to pre-pandemic commuting patterns, directly boosting RETAIL_REC within the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -20.0% from baseline in any of the next two weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -20.0% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC does not show a net increase over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued decrease in time spent at home (RESIDENTIAL) combined with a decline in outdoor recreational activity (PARKS) suggests a behavioral shift towards indoor or commercial leisure options, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, while RESIDENTIAL continues to decrease and PARKS also decreases.

mechanism_narrative: Stable grocery and pharmacy visits, remaining within +/- 2% of baseline, indicate a consistent and predictable policy environment regarding essential services, providing a stable foundation for discretionary RETAIL_REC to increase as broader mobility restrictions ease over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains between -2.0% and 2.0% from baseline
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains stable within the specified range, but RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 28 days.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC at t+1w is lower than or equal to RETAIL_REC at t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent and sustained recovery in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility, with both showing positive week-on-week changes, signifies a broad return to daily routines and increased out-of-home activity, which will directly translate into higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 9.0% from baseline in the next week
